name: 23-python-ini-parser
prompt: Create ini.py with a function parse(text) that parses INI text and returns a dict mapping section names to dicts of key/value pairs. Rules: sections are `[name]` lines; keys are `key = value` (spaces around `=` optional); lines starting with `#` or `;` are comments, and a ` ;` or ` #` (space then the character) after a value or after a section header starts a trailing comment that is ignored; blank lines are ignored; values may be double- or single-quoted, in which case the quotes are stripped and everything inside is kept verbatim (including spaces and `#`/`;`); unquoted values `true`/`false` in any case become booleans and unquoted values that are valid integers (optional sign, digits) become ints, everything else stays a string; a repeated key keeps the last value; a repeated section merges into the earlier one; keys before any section header go into a section named `DEFAULT`; a line that is not a comment, section or key=value raises ValueError, as does a section header without the closing bracket. Empty input returns {}.
check:
cat > zz_hidden_test.py <<'HIDDEN_EOF'
import unittest
from ini import parse


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse("[a]\nx = 1\ny=hello\n"), {"a": {"x": 1, "y": "hello"}})

    def test_comments_and_blank_lines(self):
        text = "# top\n\n[s] ; trailing comment\nk = v ; note\n; another\n  # indented\n"
        self.assertEqual(parse(text), {"s": {"k": "v"}})

    def test_types(self):
        d = parse("[t]\na = true\nb = FALSE\nc = -12\nd = 007\ne = 1.5\nf = \"true\"\n")["t"]
        self.assertIs(d["a"], True)
        self.assertIs(d["b"], False)
        self.assertEqual(d["c"], -12)
        self.assertEqual(d["d"], 7)
        self.assertEqual(d["e"], "1.5")
        self.assertEqual(d["f"], "true")

    def test_quotes_keep_spaces_and_hashes(self):
        d = parse("[q]\np = \"  a # b  \"\nr = 'x;y'\n")["q"]
        self.assertEqual(d["p"], "  a # b  ")
        self.assertEqual(d["r"], "x;y")

    def test_last_wins_and_sections_merge(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse("[a]\nk=1\n[b]\nk=2\n[a]\nk=3\nj=4\n"), {"a": {"k": 3, "j": 4}, "b": {"k": 2}})

    def test_keys_before_any_section_go_to_default(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse("k = v\n[a]\n"), {"DEFAULT": {"k": "v"}, "a": {}})

    def test_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse("[a]\nno equals sign\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse("[unclosed\n")
        self.assertEqual(parse(""), {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
HIDDEN_EOF
